title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：virus　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 virus 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the observer ① studyed the virus that no assistant in the observatory would have noted, and he said the studying was the whole of the night. The ② virus, meaning the germ itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a virus, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ virus in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ virus at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A virus, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the observer said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the virus was the whole of the matter, meaning the threat and not the germ. The ⑥ virus, meaning the threat and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; virus, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a germ and a threat. He said the threat is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ virus had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ virus of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of noting; virus, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ virus I remember is the germ noted in the log, which closed in 1980 and is still noted as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ virus, my mother said in 1982, is the only germ that improves by being noted; every virus, she said, is a threat that has agreed to look like a germ. She said the threat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 病毒（指观测站里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 病毒（指那种病毒本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the virus 研究这一种病毒
D. n. 病毒（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 病毒之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的病毒之事）
F. n. 病毒（指观测记录里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 病毒、隐患（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐患（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the virus that no assistant in the observatory would have noted
The virus, meaning the germ itself and not the lens
the virus at the far dome
the virus was the whole of the matter
the virus had become a line in a log
The virus of the whole thing
A virus, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: study the virus 意为“研究这一种病毒”，1973 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯记下的一种病毒做了一遍。
virus 意为“病毒”，指那种病毒本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
virus 意为“病毒”，指观测站里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
virus 意为“病毒”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
virus 意为“病毒、隐患”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种隐患就是那件事的全部。
virus 意为“隐患”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种病毒，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
virus 意为“病毒”，指观测记录里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1978 年这一种成了观测记录里的一行。
virus 意为“病毒之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的病毒之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的记下。
virus 意为“病毒”，我记得的是观测记录里记下过的那一种，1980 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一种。
virus 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，病毒是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的病毒。

那种病毒，指的是那种病毒本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。（virus）
那处观测站里每一种病毒旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（virus）
最远那座圆顶那种病毒，指的是他们留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（virus）
叔叔说这种隐患就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种病毒。（virus）
